_meta.description: Phase 1 of the Order/Contract consolidation: the generic base-Order layer (orderType discriminator + shared core) added additively to the existing Order schema, plus the Payment and OrderLine related objects that order extensions attach (deposits, disbursements, reclaims, lines). Non-destructive — extensions (Grant/Booking/SalesOrder/PurchaseOrder/Engagement) allOf this base in phase 2; data migrations in phase 4.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Base order/agreement primitive. Concrete order kinds (sales, purchase, grant, booking, engagement, quote, blanket) extend this via JSON-Schema allOf and add their own tail; payments and lines are related objects, not fields.

orderType.description: The kind of order — the discriminator selecting the extension + lifecycle. Existing booking orders default to 'booking'.

direction.description: incoming (we receive/are awarded) vs outgoing (we issue/award).

counterpartyId.description: Supplier / customer / grantee / contractor party id.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms (universal enough to stay a base field).

totalAmount.description: Headline amount (order total / awarded amount / engagement value).

projectReference.description: Optional project this order is for.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: A payment related to an Order (or invoice). Generalises the booking DepositPayment and the grant disbursement/reclaim amounts so the order detail can render a Payments widget instead of carrying amount fields. Deposits, installments, grant disbursements and reclaims are all Payment rows.

orderId.description: The Order this payment belongs to.

paymentType.description: deposit (booking) / installment / disbursement (grant uitbetaald) / reclaim (grant teruggevorderd) / final / refund.

linkedInvoiceId.description: Invoice this payment settles, if any.

OrderLine.title: Order Line
OrderLine.description: A line on an Order — the unified successor of QuoteLine / SalesOrderLine. Related object, not an inline array, so lines are queryable + reusable across order types.

orderId.description: The Order this line belongs to.
